title: Nurturing Filipino Tempeh Pancit Bihon
description: A comforting herb-infused pancit that blends crispy tempeh with fresh vegetables and silky rice noodles for a cozy meal.
instructions: Slice tempeh into 1/2-inch cubes and marinate with coconut aminos, minced garlic, and grated ginger for 5 minutes.
Heat sesame oil in a large pan over medium heat and saute the tempeh cubes until golden brown, about 6 minutes.
Remove the tempeh and set aside; in the same pan add sliced bell pepper, julienned carrot, and sliced onion, cooking until just tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in bean sprouts and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan, pouring in coconut aminos and a splash of water, then stir to combine.
Return the tempeh to the pan, season with salt and pepper, and cook for an additional 3 minutes to let flavors meld.
Transfer the pancit to a serving dish and garnish with sliced scallions and toasted sesame seeds.
Serve hot, optionally squeezing a little lime juice over the top for brightness.
